HediffDef.label: wraith hibernation
HediffDef.description: The Wraith has deliberately collapsed its metabolism into a deep survival state. Life-force consumption is reduced to two percent of normal and regeneration nearly stops until the hibernation cycle ends.

HediffDef.label: wraith feeding stock
HediffDef.description: The Wraith have classified this captive as a renewable feeding reserve. They are deliberately keeping the subject alive between controlled feeding cycles rather than consuming them immediately.

HediffDef.label: wraith experiment subject
HediffDef.description: Repeated Wraith examinations and invasive biological testing have left lingering neurological and motor disruption. The subject is being studied as well as fed upon.

HediffDef.label: wraith-conditioned captive
HediffDef.description: Prolonged psychic pressure has begun to erode the captive's independent responses. The conditioning is not yet full enthrallment, but the target has become unusually receptive to Wraith influence.

HediffDef.label: wraith experimental insight
HediffDef.description: Fresh observations from a living captive have sharpened this Wraith's understanding of biological systems. Research work is temporarily accelerated while the observations remain vivid.

HediffDef.label: telepathically probed
HediffDef.description: A Wraith has forced its way into this pawn's surface thoughts. The lingering intrusion disrupts concentration, awareness and resistance to further psychological pressure.

HediffDef.label: wraith hallucinations
HediffDef.description: The target's senses are being flooded with a Wraith-generated false perception. Movement, sight and conscious processing are impaired until the psychic imprint fades.

HediffDef.label: hive sense focus
HediffDef.description: The Wraith is actively extending its awareness through nearby minds and biological signals, sharpening perception at the cost of divided attention.

HediffDef.label: queen's hive authority
HediffDef.description: A living Wraith Queen is actively coordinating this pawn through the local hive network. Shared intent sharpens movement, manipulation and conscious response.

HediffDef.label: provisional hive coordination
HediffDef.description: An acting Wraith regent is holding the local hive network together after the loss of its Queen. Coordination has returned, but it is weaker and less instinctive than true Queen authority.

HediffDef.label: queenless hive disruption
HediffDef.description: The local Wraith hive has lost its Queen and has not yet resolved succession. Telepathic command fragments into competing impulses, impairing coordination and conscious response.

HediffDef.label: acting hive regent
HediffDef.description: This Wraith has assumed provisional authority after the death of a Queen. The role can restore basic hive coordination, but it does not equal the biological and psychic authority of a true Queen.
